description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all . 
 Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.
 
 Deploy and test AI solutions that simulate customer environments - specific focus around the characterization of training and inference workloads, including DLRM, Image Segmentation, Large Language Models, and Generative AI. Collect and analyze storage traces of workloads, uncovering and classifying unique IO behavior. Devise and implement suitable benchmarking strategies, drawing from industry standards, 
devices and monitor system resource utilization. Analyze system level bottlenecks and solve issues involving virtualization technologies, distributed storage architectures, and complex application workload environments. Interpret findings and results, summarizing into standard methodologies, white papers, and presentations to help SSD engineering understand unique workload requirements. Work with multi-functional teams and key industry partners to deliver prescriptive guidance, positioning our storage products in premier application environments. Contribute to continuous improvement feedback to Micron product development organizations. Meet project schedules with a high degree of fidelity. Present workload performance data and storage insights at industry trade shows.

 Employer will accept a Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering or related field and 84 months of experience in experience in the job offered or in a related occupation.  
  
 Position requires:
 1. Data center storage system architecture.
2. Networking for storage: RDMA.
3. AI workloads from a storage perspective.
4. Programming language, including C, C++, or Python.
5. Hypervisors, SDS, and cloud storage stacks, including Weka, Lustre, Ceph, Docker, Linux Containers, VMware, or AWS / Microsoft Azure.
6. Synthetic I/O characterization and related tools, including FIO, Blktrace, or diskspd.
7. Operating systems and associated internal storage stacks: Linux, Microsoft.

 The US base salary range that Micron Technology, Inc. estimates it could pay for this full-time position is $240,350.00 - $325,000.00 per Year per Year. For additional pay & benefits information, please refer to the requisition at Micron.com/careers.
 
 
 As a world leader in the semiconductor industry, Micron is dedicated to your personal wellbeing and professional growth. Micron benefits are designed to help you stay well, provide peace of mind and help you prepare for the future.  We offer a choice of medical, dental and vision plans in all locations enabling team members to select the plans that best meet their family healthcare needs and budget.  Micron also provides benefit programs that help protect your income if you are unable to work due to illness or injury, and paid family leave.  Additionally, Micron benefits include a robust paid time-off program and paid holidays.   For additional information regarding the Benefit programs available, please see the Benefits Guide posted on micron.com/careers/benefits .
